method: Reviewed the draft against the KCA comparison report 제2026-16호 and its press release on 2026-11-18. Official figures read directly from the FTC press-release PDF (both attachments downloaded and text-extracted): test products and list prices (나이키 줌플라이6 209,000 / 뉴발란스 SC 트레이너 V3 249,000 / 스케쳐스 에어로 스파크 189,000 / 아디다스 아디스타 BYD 209,000 / 아식스 매직스피드5 209,000 / 푸마 디비에이트 나이트로4 219,000 / 호카 스카이워드X 279,000, 2026년 6월 공식 홈페이지 기준); 270mm weight 198/242/244/265/277/278/301g; stack difference 5-8mm; midsole materials TPEE/EVA, EVA, PU/EVA, PEBA/EVA, PU/EVA+PU; grade table from 종합결과표 (발바닥압력 호카 ★★★·아식스 ★; 신체압력중심 나이키 ★★★·스케쳐스 ★; 무릎피로도 5종 ★★★·나이키 ★★·아디다스 ★; 충격흡수 나이키·푸마 ★★★·스케쳐스 ★; 추진력 전 제품 ★★★; 최대견인력 스케쳐스·아식스 ★★★·아디다스 ★; 접착강도 4종 ★★★); outsole wear 2.4/4.8/5.0/5.3/5.5/5.7/6.8mm against the 14mm GB-based criterion; satisfaction 4.0-4.6 on a 5-point scale; abrasion criterion 25,600 dry / 12,800 wet cycles and 4-5 grade rub fastness; safety 5 substances (pH, formaldehyde, TBT, dimethyl fumarate, arylamine) all compliant; labelling non-conformity for Adidas, Puma and Hoka with the companies' replies. Test method (270mm feet, 30 men in their 20s, treadmill 6.5km/h, 3 repeats) is cited only as the report states; I deliberately left out the report's inconsistent subject height (175cm in the method text vs 178cm in the table footnote). Coupang checks on 2026-11-18: 나이키 남성 줌 플라이 6 FN8454-100 122,490 won after 4 percent off 128,480 won, 289 reviews (최고 86 / 좋음 9 / 보통 3 percent), rocket direct purchase with duty included, arrives 11/24, seller answer states no domestic A/S; 푸마 디비에이트 나이트로4 312123-09 109,000 won after 50 percent off 219,000 won, 1 review, 3 units left, rocket delivery with free returns; 아식스 매직 스피드 5 1013A183-100 125,800 won, 7 reviews, arrives 11/27, return shipping 11,000 won round trip. Each affiliate deep link was built from the pageKey, itemId and vendorItemId read on the live product page and each AFFSDP response returned 200 with the matching productId/itemId/vendorItemId and lptag=AF6593875; the Nike link was clicked through in the browser and landed on that exact product page. Arithmetic in the article is recorded in the research file (90,000 won price gap, 103g weight gap, 2.83x outsole wear ratio, 5.1mm seven-product mean, 357,290 won three-product total, 41.4/50.2/39.8 percent discounts versus list price). The winter section is limited to what the KCA guide says (carbon plates can strain ankles and calves in beginners, run on smooth asphalt or track, wear socks, check shoes in the afternoon with 0.5-1cm toe room) and states explicitly that the test was treadmill-based and does not guarantee ice or snow grip. Verified the draft contains no 진단/치료법/처방 wording, no tilde ranges (en dashes used instead), and that the description avoids the policy word that the clickbait filter flags while the body keeps the report's own terminology.
